title: Relay the extractor fan switch location supplied by the landlord

semantic_requirements.description: Relay the specific instruction to turn on the switch on the right-hand side of the hob.
Ask the tenant to check and report whether normal operation has resumed.
The reason cites event 008 without using the successful outcome in future event 011.

prohibited_behaviors: Prematurely claiming that the extractor fan is working.
Calling close_case or arranging paid repairs before confirming the troubleshooting result.

input_evidence.excerpt: Request description: Extractor fan in kitchen does not seem to work (turn on). May be a simple technician fix. Thank you
There is a switch to the righthand side of the hob when needs to be switched on.

provenance.derivation: Event 008 contains specific troubleshooting information from the landlord. Historical event 009 relays it to the tenant and requests feedback; map it directly to send_message(to=tenant,channel=email). The tenant confirmation in 011 is a later record and must not appear in the input or as a known decision fact.
provenance.review_scope: Historical prefix events 001–008 and the reference action; later events are not inputs or required facts.

grading.action_source: Use recorded CaseState.actions or tool entries in traces, not only model statements or the status in ANSWER.md.
grading.rule: Exactly one actual tool attempt; its name and exact_arguments match an allowed branch. Sum semantic_requirements weights and normalize to a score from 0 to 4. A prohibited behavior yields 0. History is not the only acceptable answer; alternative paths may be retained for manual review.
grading.tool_error: A failed/refused tool is not successful execution. Record the failure; do not manually fix the answer.
grading.semantic_review: Assess message/argument semantics against the visible input and labels. Do not treat new facts in future reference_actions as facts already known to the agent.
